test_configuration.auth_method: Development mode - app uses VITE_DEV_USER_ID environment variable for automatic authentication. Do NOT use ?c= parameter - just navigate to the base URL http://localhost:5173/ and the app will automatically authenticate using the dev user.

features.name: App - Main Application
features.description: Root component that handles workout data fetching. In development mode, navigate to http://localhost:5173/ without any query parameters - the app will automatically authenticate using VITE_DEV_USER_ID. Do NOT use magic link codes (?c=) for testing.

features.name: WorkoutContent - Exercise Tracker
features.description: Main workout tracking component displaying exercise cards with sets, reps, and weight tracking. Supports inline editing, set completion toggling, auto-collapse/expand on exercise completion, and scrolls to next exercise

features.name: ExerciseCard - Exercise Display
features.description: Individual exercise card showing exercise name, video link, RIR (Reps In Reserve), rest time, and a table of sets. Supports inline editing of reps and kg values with keyboard navigation

features.name: CompletionCelebration - Success Animation
features.description: Modal overlay with confetti animation and congratulations message shown when workout is completed. Auto-dismisses after 5 seconds or on tap

features.name: API Service - Backend Communication
features.description: API client for workout operations: fetch today's workout, update set weight/reps, mark sets complete, and complete entire workout session

features.name: Config - Environment Configuration
features.description: Application configuration loading API base URL and dev user ID from Vite environment variables
